recognize_zh: 這是 VWF multimer 凝膠電泳圖：第 1 型所有大小的 multimer 都在但整體變淡；2A 缺高分子量與中分子量 multimer；2B 只缺最大的高分子量 multimer，要跟正常血漿（NP）比對梯狀條帶。
features: NP (normal plasma): full ladder of VWF multimers from low to highest molecular weight with even intensity
Type 1: all multimer sizes present with normal distribution but uniformly reduced intensity (quantitative deficiency)
Type 2A: loss of high- and intermediate-molecular-weight multimers, with relative excess of low-molecular-weight bands
Type 2B: selective loss of the largest multimers, with intermediate and low bands preserved
Low-resolution gel; satellite-band (triplet) structure cannot be assessed in this image
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic figure showing a von Willebrand factor multimer analysis by SDS-agarose gel electrophoresis with immunoblotting. The normal plasma lane shows a complete ladder extending to the highest molecular weight multimers. The type 1 lane shows a normal multimer distribution with globally decreased intensity, consistent with a partial quantitative deficiency. The type 2A lane lacks high- and intermediate-molecular-weight multimers, while the type 2B lane lacks only the largest multimers. Interpretation requires correlation with VWF:Ag, VWF activity (VWF:RCo/GPIbM), FVIII and, for 2B, low-dose RIPA.

ddx.vs: It shows the same loss of high-molecular-weight multimers as 2B, but the defect lies in platelet GPIbA and is distinguished by platelet-plasma mixing RIPA studies or GP1BA sequencing.

ddx.dx: Acquired von Willebrand syndrome (e.g. aortic stenosis, LVAD, MPN with thrombocytosis)
ddx.vs: It can produce a 2A-like loss of large multimers but occurs without family history and resolves with treatment of the underlying condition.
Both have a normal multimer distribution; 2M has a reduced activity:antigen ratio and 2N a disproportionately low FVIII with defective FVIII binding.
Multimers are essentially undetectable rather than reduced or selectively lost.
